_comment: HTTP 404. Meaning depends on the endpoint - on the events endpoints it is a NORMAL, EXPECTED empty result, not an error.
_body_warning: TrainingPeaks returns an HTML error page for nonexistent routes, not JSON. Do not assume a parseable body.

_meaning_by_endpoint.GET /v2/events/next: No upcoming events. Not an error - treat as an empty result.
_meaning_by_endpoint.GET /v2/events/{date}: No events on that date. Not an error - treat as an empty result.
_meaning_by_endpoint.GET /v2/workouts/id/{id}: Workout does not exist or was deleted.
_meaning_by_endpoint.PUT /v2/workouts/plan/{id}: Workout was deleted on TrainingPeaks since it was last read.
_meaning_by_endpoint.any unrecognised path: Route does not exist (401 means 'exists, needs auth'; 404 means 'does not exist').
